description: Workspace graph read model (MSN-SURFACE-UNIFY-20261103): read-only join of missions, projects, organizations, work items, approvals, agent identities, tenant profiles and member profiles for libs/core/surface/workspace-graph.ts. It is never tenant-bound: rows are filtered afterwards by the caller's server-resolved SurfaceAuthorizationContext (viewerAdmitsNode), so a client tenant can only narrow. No write grant; persona worker.
